messages:
Maya (ENG Manager): hey team — I'm moving Priya from IC -> Eng Manager, effective 2026-05-15. Need clarity on comp change, benefits enrollment, and payroll cutoffs. who owns what?
Ava (People Ops): congrats! :tada: quick outline: 1) compensation change form -> People Ops 2) HRIS title & manager field update -> Hiring Ops 3) payroll proration/backpay -> Payroll 4) benefits new-enroll window -> People Ops benefits team. share employee id?
Maya (ENG Manager): emp id is RWI-2019. also curious about equity strike timing and bonus eligibility (the company bonus cycle closed in March).
Diego (Hiring Ops): noted RWI-2019. I'll open the HRIS ticket to update title/manager and set effective date. ETA: end of day tomorrow if no blockers. JIRA #HRIS-4827.
Ava (People Ops): thanks. for comp change, please fill this internal form: https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/comp-change (select "manager conversion" and attach evidence). Once submitted we'll route for approvals. The form fields to double-check: new base, new band, effective_date, PRORATE_FLAG.
Maya (ENG Manager): do we need a separate manager-level role req or is this just a title/comp change?
Diego (Hiring Ops): if headcount doesn't change, no req needed. This is a reclassification -> HRIS update only. I'll mark headcount unchanged.
Sam (Payroll): payroll cutoff for a 2026-05-15 effective date: payroll runs on the 1st and 15th. To get full prorate in the 15th cycle we need approvals + HRIS change completed by 2026-05-05 17:00 PT. Otherwise proration goes to the next cycle and backpay may be split.
Maya (ENG Manager): got it. what's the proration calc?
Sam (Payroll): we use calendar days in period. Example: effective 2026-05-15 with change submitted by cutoff -> payroll pays prorated base for 1-15 (employee portion covers 15 days). Backpay if approvals are delayed: payroll will issue retro in next cycle.
Ava (People Ops): benefits note: manager role opens enrollment for manager-specific plans (manager wellbeing stipend, enhanced FSA match) but that only takes effect at the start of the next benefit month unless it's within the 30-day new-eligibility window. For a 5/15 change, open enrollment window closes 30 days after effective date — please confirm acceptance in Workday Benefits page.
Maya (ENG Manager): so Priya has 30 days from 5/15 to enroll in manager options, otherwise she waits until open enrollment in November?
Ava (People Ops): correct, 30-day special enrollment window applies. HR Bot will DM employee with next steps when we flip the role.
HR Bot: automated reminder: submit comp-change form -> https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/comp-change. Approval chain: manager -> director -> finance -> people-ops.
Maya (ENG Manager): any change to sign-on equity or refresh schedule? Priya had an upcoming refresh scheduled 2026-07-01.
Ava (People Ops): refresh schedule unaffected by role change; grants follow existing cadence unless compensation or level triggers a formal grant amendment. If you want a level-based equity adjustment, start a formal equity-change request (link on the comp form). That takes 2-3 weeks for grants team.
Diego (Hiring Ops): small ops note: I'll also update manager-direct-report mapping and Org chart so manager-level approvals start flowing.
Sam (Payroll): FYI timezone gotcha: Maya is EMEA-based, payroll cutoff times are PT. If approvals are submitted late due to timezone, we still rely on PT cutoff.
Maya (ENG Manager): ack — I'll aim to have form in by Tues 5/04 PT.
Ava (People Ops): perfect. next steps checklist for Maya: 1) submit comp-change form (attach updated manager job spec) 2) reply here when done 3) confirm manager welcome & 1:1s scheduled. We'll follow up on benefits enrollment DM.
Maya (ENG Manager): done — submitted form and attached spec.
Ava (People Ops): received. routing for approvals now. I'll add you and Priya to HR Bot enrollment reminders and cc Payroll. :thumbsup:
Sam (Payroll): received JIRA and comp-change. I'll queue payroll actions pending final approval.
Maya (ENG Manager): thanks all. tagging @Priya to expect DMs from HR Bot.
Priya (IC -> Eng Manager): hi all — thanks! quick Q: do I need to re-enroll dependents for manager medical?
Ava (People Ops): no, dependents stay unless you update them. Manager plan options are on top of current coverage; if you change plans you may need to re-enter dependent info. I'll DM details.
HR Bot: reminder scheduled: 2026-05-16 09:00 PT -> benefits special enrollment prompt to RWI-2019.
Ava (People Ops): closing note — if anyone needs manual backpay calculations before approval completes, ping payroll (Sam) with the approved effective_date and final comp numbers.
Maya (ENG Manager): appreciated — closing thread once Payroll confirms.
Sam (Payroll): will post when retro scheduled.
Maya (ENG Manager): thanks :heart:
